path.description: The data file, Zarr store or ADIOS2 .bp directory; relative to the server's working directory or absolute.

format.description: The format when the extension or content does not say: csv, tsv, json, jsonl, hdf5, netcdf, parquet, zarr, adios2.

variable.description: HDF5, NetCDF and Zarr: the variable or group path; ADIOS2: the variable name; Parquet stats: the column.

delimiter.description: CSV and TSV: the one delimiter character, or \t.

header.description: CSV and TSV: "auto" (default) detects a header row; true or false forces it.

sample_rows.description: Rows or top-level members kept as the sample: default 10, at most 1000.

max_rows.description: Rows scanned before the view becomes sampled: default 100000; null scans the whole file.

variable.description: HDF5, NetCDF and Zarr: the variable or group path; ADIOS2: the variable name; Parquet stats: the column.

start.description: HDF5, NetCDF and Zarr: the 0-based first index per dimension (default 0).

count.description: HDF5, NetCDF and Zarr: elements per dimension (default: the rest of each dimension).

stride.description: HDF5, NetCDF and Zarr: the step per dimension (default 1).

offset.description: The 0-based first row, record or array element; Parquet stats: the first row.

limit.description: Rows returned: default 50, at most 1000; Parquet stats: rows summarized (default all).

columns.description: CSV and TSV: header names or 0-based indices to project; Parquet: column names.

pointer.description: JSON: an RFC 6901 pointer to the value to return; "" is the whole document.
